label: Looking back over the past year has there been anything, or any bad news that has really shaken and upset you, or that has been a big disappointment to you? - at age 36 years
meta_rows: Looking back over the past year has there been anything, or any bad news that has really shaken and upset you, or that has been a big disappointment to you? - at age 36 years
Life events asked in the 1982 A questionnaire. These questions slightly different to other sweeps. Relation does not specifically exclude partner.
cat_rows: This category contains data from the questionnaires on life events such as serious illness and disability, accidents, robbery, disagreements with spouse and relatives, difficulties with children and grandchildren, major breavement or disappointments.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
